result.title: Foresee to Trade: Forecast-Augmented Policy Optimization for Portfolio Management
result.summary: Online investment services must translate asset opportunities into investment outcomes for users' accounts, yet the same market opportunity can warrant different account actions. We study how supervision from future asset opportunities can strengthen account-level trading decisions and propose Forecast-Augmented Relative Policy Optimization (FRPO). FRPO separately supervises asset opportunities and account decisions through a jointly learned representation: a Financial State Head (FSH) learns future relative-return targets to provide asset-level opportunity supervision, while Same-Path Group-Relative Optimization compares trading trajectories under the same market path and initial account to provide account-level relative-outcome supervision. An Adaptive Gate coordinates auxiliary supervision using predictive variance and gradient alignment. FSH is used only during training; inference uses the encoder and policy for trading. Across DJIA30, TOPIX Core30, and three investment-style portfolios, ten-seed evaluations show that FRPO achieves the highest mean cumulative and annualized returns among the compared methods in all five settings. These results support strengthening investment agents' trading decisions through joint supervision from asset opportunities and trading outcomes.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FRPO，在金融交易决策中联合学习表征：训练期用 Financial State Head 预测未来相对收益以提供资产层面监督，并以同路径分组相对优化比较账户轨迹，自适应门控按预测方差与梯度对齐调节辅助监督，该头仅在训练期使用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「辅助预测头仅训练期存在、推理只保留编码器与策略」以及按预测方差和梯度对齐门控辅助损失的做法，可供核查 LVR 中如何在不增加推理成本的前提下为 latent 状态施加监督并调节多目标贡献。
